name: Advantage - Post Outbound GHL Disposition to Bonzo

parameters.content:
## Advantage - Disposition -> Bonzo

SynthFlow disposition POSTs here; PATCHes the Bonzo lead.

FILL: REPLACE_BONZO_BASE_URL, REPLACE_BONZO_STATUS_KEY, and confirm the two status values.
Bonzo node: set the auth credential (Bearer/Header per Bonzo docs) — never hardcode the key.
Confirm GHL sends: leadid, stage_name, note_html.
